mapper.sql: q.quest_id, bp.battle_id, bp.guild_id, bp.user_id, bp.snapshot_nickname AS nickname, bp.snapshot_profile_image_url AS profile_image_url, bp.snapshot_character_id AS character_id, bp.snapshot_character_name AS character_name, bp.snapshot_character_level AS character_level, q.quest_template_id, q.title, q.description, q.quest_type, q.condition_category, q.metric_type, q.comparison_type, q.aggregation_type, q.evaluation_scope, q.threshold_value, q.threshold_min_value, q.threshold_max_value, q.threshold_unit, q.target_value, q.current_value, q.unit, q.damage, q.reward_exp, q.reward_coin, q.status, q.source_type, bp.status AS participant_status, bp.left_at AS participant_left_at, CASE WHEN bp.user_id = #{currentUserId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_me, q.created_at, q.completed_at, q.rewarded_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM boss_battle_participants bp LEFT JOIN quests q ON q.battle_id = bp.battle_id AND q.user_id = bp.user_id WHERE bp.battle_id = #{battleId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN bp.user_id = #{currentUserId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE q.status WHEN 'IN_PROGRESS' THEN 1 WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN 2 WHEN 'REWARDED' THEN 3 WHEN 'EXPIRED' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END, bp.joined_at ASC, bp.participant_id ASC

SELECT q.quest_id, q.battle_id, q.guild_id, q.user_id, q.quest_template_id, bp.snapshot_nickname AS nickname, bp.snapshot_profile_image_url AS profile_image_url, bp.snapshot_character_id AS character_id, bp.snapshot_character_name AS character_name, bp.snapshot_character_level AS character_level, q.title, q.description, q.quest_type, q.condition_category, q.metric_type, q.comparison_type, q.aggregation_type, q.evaluation_scope, q.threshold_value, q.threshold_min_value, q.threshold_max_value, q.threshold_unit, q.target_value, q.current_value, q.unit, q.damage, q.reward_exp, q.reward_coin, q.status, q.source_type, bp.status AS participant_status, bp.left_at AS participant_left_at, TRUE AS is_me, q.created_at, q.completed_at, q.rewarded_at FROM quests q JOIN boss_battle_participants bp ON bp.battle_id = q.battle_id AND bp.user_id = q.user_id WHERE q.battle_id = #{battleId} AND q.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM quests q JOIN boss_battle_participants bp ON bp.battle_id = q.battle_id AND bp.user_id = q.user_id WHERE q.quest_id = #{questId}

SELECT quest_id, battle_id, guild_id, user_id, quest_template_id, title, description, quest_type, condition_category, metric_type, comparison_type, aggregation_type, evaluation_scope, threshold_value, threshold_min_value, threshold_max_value, threshold_unit, target_value, current_value, unit, damage, reward_exp, reward_coin, status, source_type, created_at, completed_at, rewarded_at, updated_at FROM quests WHERE battle_id = #{battleId} AND user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quests ( battle_id, guild_id, user_id, quest_template_id, title, description, quest_type, condition_category, metric_type, comparison_type, aggregation_type, evaluation_scope, threshold_value, threshold_min_value, threshold_max_value, threshold_unit, target_value, current_value, unit, damage, reward_exp, reward_coin, status, source_type ) VALUES ( #{battleId}, #{guildId}, #{userId}, #{questTemplateId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{questType}, #{conditionCategory}, #{metricType}, #{comparisonType}, #{aggregationType}, #{evaluationScope}, #{thresholdValue}, #{thresholdMinValue}, #{thresholdMaxValue}, #{thresholdUnit}, #{targetValue}, COALESCE(#{currentValue}, 0), #{unit}, COALESCE(#{damage}, 0), COALESCE(#{rewardExp}, 0), COALESCE(#{rewardCoin}, 0), COALESCE(#{status}, 'IN_PROGRESS'), COALESCE(#{sourceType}, 'PLACEHOLDER') )
mapper.select: SELECT bb.battle_id, bb.guild_id, bb.status, bb.max_hp, b.difficulty FROM boss_battles bb JOIN bosses b ON b.boss_id = bb.boss_id WHERE bb.battle_id = #{battleId}

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM guild_members gm JOIN users u ON u.user_id = gm.user_id WHERE gm.guild_id = #{guildId} AND gm.user_id = #{userId} AND gm.left_at IS NULL AND u.status = 'ACTIVE'

SELECT gm.guild_member_id AS member_id, gm.user_id, u.nickname, u.profile_image_url, c.character_id, c.name AS character_name, c.level AS character_level FROM guild_members gm JOIN users u ON u.user_id = gm.user_id LEFT JOIN characters c ON c.user_id = gm.user_id WHERE gm.guild_id = #{guildId} AND gm.left_at IS NULL AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY gm.joined_at ASC, gm.guild_member_id ASC

SELECT bp.user_id, bp.snapshot_nickname AS nickname, bp.snapshot_profile_image_url AS profile_image_url, bp.snapshot_character_name AS character_name, bp.snapshot_character_level AS character_level, COUNT(q.quest_id) AS total_quest_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'REWARDED') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed_quest_count, SUM(CASE WHEN q.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'REWARDED') THEN q.damage ELSE 0 END) AS total_damage, COALESCE(SUM(q.damage), 0) AS expected_damage, bp.status AS participant_status, bp.left_at, CASE WHEN bp.user_id = #{currentUserId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_me FROM boss_battle_participants bp LEFT JOIN quests q ON q.battle_id = bp.battle_id AND q.user_id = bp.user_id WHERE bp.battle_id = #{battleId} GROUP BY bp.user_id, bp.snapshot_nickname, bp.snapshot_profile_image_url, bp.snapshot_character_name, bp.snapshot_character_level, bp.status, bp.left_at ORDER BY completed_quest_count DESC, total_damage DESC, bp.user_id ASC

SELECT quest_id, battle_id, guild_id, user_id, quest_template_id, title, description, quest_type, condition_category, metric_type, comparison_type, aggregation_type, evaluation_scope, threshold_value, threshold_min_value, threshold_max_value, threshold_unit, target_value, current_value, unit, damage, reward_exp, reward_coin, status, source_type, created_at, completed_at, rewarded_at, updated_at FROM quests WHERE quest_id = #{questId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE quests SET status = 'COMPLETED', current_value = #{currentValue}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE quest_id = #{questId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
UPDATE quests SET status = 'REWARDED', rewarded_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE quest_id = #{questId} AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND rewarded_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT quest_id, battle_id, guild_id, user_id, quest_template_id, title, description, quest_type, condition_category, metric_type, comparison_type, aggregation_type, evaluation_scope, threshold_value, threshold_min_value, threshold_max_value, threshold_unit, target_value, current_value, unit, damage, reward_exp, reward_coin, status, source_type, created_at, completed_at, rewarded_at, updated_at FROM quests WHERE battle_id = #{battleId} AND status = 'COMPLETED' AND rewarded_at IS NULL ORDER BY quest_id ASC
SELECT user_id FROM boss_battle_participants WHERE battle_id = #{battleId} ORDER BY participant_id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE boss_battles SET status = 'EXPIRED', ended_at = COALESCE(ended_at, #{now}), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bosses b JOIN boss_seasons s ON s.season_id = b.season_id WHERE b.boss_id = boss_battles.boss_id AND CAST(CONCAT(CAST(COALESCE(b.ends_at, s.end_date) AS DATE), ' 23:59:59') AS DATETIME) < #{now} )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT bb.battle_id FROM boss_battles bb JOIN bosses b ON b.boss_id = bb.boss_id JOIN boss_seasons s ON s.season_id = bb.season_id WHERE CAST(CONCAT(CAST(COALESCE(b.ends_at, s.end_date) AS DATE), ' 23:59:59') AS DATETIME) < #{now} AND ( ( bb.status = 'DEFEATED' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM boss_battle_participants bp WHERE bp.battle_id = bb.battle_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM reward_claims rc WHERE rc.user_id = bp.user_id AND rc.source_type = 'BOSS_BATTLE' AND rc.source_id = bb.battle_id ) ) ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM quests q WHERE q.battle_id = bb.battle_id AND q.status = 'COMPLETED' AND q.rewarded_at IS NULL ) ) ORDER BY bb.battle_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quest_verifications ( quest_id, user_id, battle_id, summary_id, diet_id, quest_type, verified, damage_amount, message, verified_date ) VALUES ( #{questId}, #{userId}, #{battleId}, #{summaryId}, #{dietId}, #{questType}, COALESCE(#{verified}, TRUE), COALESCE(#{damageAmount}, 0), #{message}, #{verifiedDate} )
mapper.select: SELECT diet_id, user_id, CAST(eaten_at AS DATE) AS summary_date, total_sugar_g FROM diets WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND eaten_at >= #{startAt} AND eaten_at < #{endAt} ORDER BY eaten_at ASC, diet_id ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE #{metricType} WHEN 'CALORIE' THEN total_calories WHEN 'PROTEIN' THEN total_protein_g WHEN 'CARBOHYDRATE' THEN total_carbs_g WHEN 'FAT' THEN total_fat_g WHEN 'SUGAR' THEN total_sugar_g WHEN 'SODIUM' THEN total_sodium_mg WHEN 'FIBER' THEN total_fiber_g WHEN 'IRON' THEN total_iron_mg WHEN 'PHOSPHORUS' THEN total_phosphorus_mg WHEN 'POTASSIUM' THEN total_potassium_mg WHEN 'VITAMIN_A' THEN total_vitamin_a_ug_rae WHEN 'BETA_CAROTENE' THEN total_beta_carotene_ug WHEN 'RETINOL' THEN total_retinol_ug ELSE 0 END ), 0) FROM diets WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND eaten_at >= #{startAt} AND eaten_at < #{endAt}

SELECT a.recorded_days, a.breakfast_days, a.lunch_days, a.dinner_days, a.snack_days, a.avg_calories, a.avg_protein_g, a.avg_carbs_g, a.avg_fat_g, a.avg_sugar_g, a.avg_sodium_mg, a.avg_fiber_g, hp.target_calories, hp.target_protein_g, hp.target_carbs_g, hp.target_fat_g FROM ( SELECT COUNT(1) AS recorded_days, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN daily.breakfast_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS breakfast_days, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN daily.lunch_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS lunch_days, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN daily.dinner_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS dinner_days, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN daily.snack_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS snack_days, COALESCE(AVG(daily.total_calories), 0) AS avg_calories, COALESCE(AVG(daily.total_protein_g), 0) AS avg_protein_g, COALESCE(AVG(daily.total_carbs_g), 0) AS avg_carbs_g, COALESCE(AVG(daily.total_fat_g), 0) AS avg_fat_g, COALESCE(AVG(daily.total_sugar_g), 0) AS avg_sugar_g, COALESCE(AVG(daily.total_sodium_mg), 0) AS avg_sodium_mg, COALESCE(AVG(daily.total_fiber_g), 0) AS avg_fiber_g FROM ( SELECT CAST(eaten_at AS DATE) AS eaten_date, SUM(total_calories) AS total_calories, SUM(total_protein_g) AS total_protein_g, SUM(total_carbs_g) AS total_carbs_g, SUM(total_fat_g) AS total_fat_g, SUM(total_sugar_g) AS total_sugar_g, SUM(total_sodium_mg) AS total_sodium_mg, SUM(total_fiber_g) AS total_fiber_g, SUM(CASE WHEN meal_type = 'BREAKFAST' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS breakfast_count, SUM(CASE WHEN meal_type = 'LUNCH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lunch_count, SUM(CASE WHEN meal_type = 'DINNER' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dinner_count, SUM(CASE WHEN meal_type = 'SNACK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS snack_count FROM diets WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND eaten_at >= #{startAt} AND eaten_at < #{endAt} GROUP BY CAST(eaten_at AS DATE) ) daily ) a LEFT JOIN health_profiles hp ON hp.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT bb.battle_id, bb.guild_id, bb.boss_id, b.name AS boss_name, b.difficulty, bb.status, bb.max_hp, bb.current_hp, bb.total_damage, b.reward_exp, b.reward_coin, bb.started_at, bb.ended_at FROM boss_battle_participants bp JOIN boss_battles bb ON bb.battle_id = bp.battle_id JOIN bosses b ON b.boss_id = bb.boss_id WHERE bp.user_id = #{userId} AND bp.status = 'ACTIVE' AND bb.status = 'IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY bb.started_at DESC, bb.battle_id DESC

SELECT bb.battle_id, bb.guild_id, bb.boss_id, b.name AS boss_name, b.difficulty, bb.status, bb.max_hp, bb.current_hp, bb.total_damage, b.reward_exp, b.reward_coin, bb.started_at, bb.ended_at FROM boss_battles bb JOIN bosses b ON b.boss_id = bb.boss_id WHERE bb.battle_id = #{battleId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT bb.battle_id, bb.guild_id, bb.boss_id, b.name AS boss_name, b.difficulty, bb.status, bb.max_hp, bb.current_hp, bb.total_damage, b.reward_exp, b.reward_coin, bb.started_at, bb.ended_at FROM boss_battles bb JOIN bosses b ON b.boss_id = bb.boss_id WHERE bb.battle_id = #{battleId}
mapper.update: UPDATE boss_battles SET current_hp = GREATEST(current_hp - #{damage}, 0), total_damage = total_damage + #{damage}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE battle_id = #{battleId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
UPDATE boss_battles SET status = 'DEFEATED', current_hp = 0, ended_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE battle_id = #{battleId} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND current_hp <= 0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO boss_battle_damage_logs ( battle_id, user_id, damage, source_type, source_id, description ) VALUES ( #{battleId}, #{userId}, #{damage}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, #{description} )
mapper.select: SELECT battle_condition_id, battle_id, condition_template_id, title, target_type, condition_category, metric_type, comparison_type, aggregation_type, evaluation_scope, threshold_value, threshold_min_value, threshold_max_value, target_value, current_value, damage, completed, required_for_clear, verification_supported FROM boss_battle_conditions WHERE battle_id = #{battleId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, battle_condition_id ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE boss_battle_conditions SET current_value = #{currentValue}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE battle_condition_id = #{battleConditionId}

UPDATE boss_battle_conditions SET current_value = #{currentValue}, completed = TRUE, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE battle_condition_id = #{battleConditionId} AND completed = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM boss_battle_conditions WHERE battle_id = #{battleId} AND completed = FALSE AND required_for_clear = TRUE AND verification_supported = TRUE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reward_claims ( user_id, source_type, source_id, xp_amount, guild_point, coin_amount ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{sourceType}, #{sourceId}, COALESCE(#{xpAmount}, 0), COALESCE(#{guildPoint}, 0), COALESCE(#{coinAmount}, 0) )
